nodes.npcLine: A young scholar looks up from his desk, ink‑stained fingers trembling. 'Oh… hello. I didn’t expect anyone to come.'
He sighs. 'I am but an apprentice, left behind when my master fled the chaos. I try to keep the scribing room in order, though it’s difficult alone.'
His eyes darken. 'My master was a great scribe, keeper of many secrets. When the library began to collapse, he told me to stay and guard the ink. He never returned.'
He gestures to the scattered scrolls. 'This room holds the drafts and copies of many works. It is not the grand archive, but here knowledge is made legible. Without ink, none of it survives.'
He holds up a small vial. 'This ink is precious. My master said it was mixed with rare minerals. I cannot use it all myself… perhaps you should take it.'
He presses the vial into your hand. 'May it serve you better than it has served me.'
He leans closer. 'If you seek wisdom, remember: the guardians test not only strength, but intent. Words can be as sharp as blades.'
He smiles faintly. 'Thank you. It is hard to be left behind, but perhaps my master trusted me more than I realised.'
The apprentice returns to his work, quill scratching faintly. 'Farewell, traveler. May your path be clearer than mine.'
